sections.title: LLM Integration Applications for New York Organizations
sections.description: Production LLM solutions for New York's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Financial Services Regulatory LLM
paragraphs: For JPMorgan Chase, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, and Wall Street's world-leading financial institutions:

Multi-regulator compliance assistants: GPT-4o via Azure OpenAI integrated over SEC rules and regulations, Federal Reserve SR letters, OCC guidance, FINRA rulebook, CFTC regulations, and NYDFS guidance — enabling compliance teams to ask natural language questions across the entire multi-regulator stack that New York banks navigate. Production-deployed compliance LLM with FINRA Rule 17a-4 electronic record keeping compliance.

Model risk documentation AI: Claude 3.5 Sonnet integrating model risk management documentation for SR 11-7 compliance — generating structured model validation evidence from backtesting results, performance monitoring reports, and limitation documentation. Reduces the manual writing burden of SR 11-7 model validation reports.

Investment research synthesis: LLM applications for Fidelity's and Morgan Stanley's New York investment research operations — RAG over earnings transcripts, SEC filings, and analyst reports enabling natural language investment research query.
Cost: $30,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | FINRA 17a-4 logging

blocks.heading: Legal Research and Knowledge LLM
paragraphs: For Sullivan & Cromwell, Davis Polk, Wachtell, and New York's BigLaw community:

Legal research assistants: Claude 3.5 Sonnet's superior long-context processing makes it the preferred LLM for legal research applications — processing full contracts, lengthy regulatory guidance, and complex court opinions without context window truncation that affects GPT-4o-turbo on very long documents.

Deal drafting assistance: LLM-powered first-draft generation from New York firm playbooks — accelerating associate drafting of merger agreements, credit agreements, and securities purchase agreements from parameterized firm precedent.

Privilege-protected knowledge systems: Self-hosted Llama 3 for the most sensitive New York legal matters — attorney-client privilege protection requiring zero external API transmission of client communications.
Cost: $30,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | Privilege RBAC, self-hosted option

blocks.heading: Healthcare Clinical LLM
paragraphs: For NewYork-Presbyterian, Memorial Sloan Kettering, and Mount Sinai:

Ambient documentation AI: Azure OpenAI GPT-4o for clinical documentation at NYP — converting physician-patient encounter audio to structured Epic clinical notes. Azure's HIPAA BAA makes Azure OpenAI the standard for New York healthcare LLM deployment.

Clinical decision support: Claude 3.5 Sonnet RAG over clinical guidelines, drug information, and hospital protocols for NYP's and MSK's clinical staff — point-of-care natural language query of evidence-based medicine.
Oncology research synthesis: LLM for MSK's clinical research community — synthesizing clinical trial results, molecular oncology literature, and institutional research for tumor board preparation.
Cost: $30,000–$90,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | HIPAA BAA (Azure/AWS)

blocks.heading: Media and Publishing Intelligence
paragraphs: For Bloomberg, Reuters, Associated Press, and New York Times:

Financial news synthesis: LLM applications for Bloomberg's financial intelligence products — real-time synthesis of market-moving news, regulatory announcements, and earnings releases into structured intelligence feeds.

Content creation assistance: LLM for New York media organizations' editorial workflows — research assistance, headline generation testing, and first-draft content from structured data for the large volume of templated financial and market content.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks

sections.title: New York LLM Deployment Preferences
sections.description: Azure OpenAI, Claude, and self-hosted Llama 3 for New York's most demanding environments.

blocks.heading: Azure OpenAI as the bank standard
paragraphs: New York's major banks largely standardize on Microsoft technology. Azure OpenAI provides GPT-4o within the existing Azure tenant with FINRA-compliant logging, Azure Active Directory authentication, and the SOC 2 / ISO 27001 compliance infrastructure that Wall Street's security requirements demand.

blocks.heading: Claude 3.5 Sonnet for legal long-context
paragraphs: New York's legal applications involving full merger agreements (200+ pages), complex regulatory guidance, and extensive deal documentation require LLM context windows that exceed GPT-4o-turbo's optimal range. Claude 3.5 Sonnet's 200K token context window handles full New York transaction documents without chunking.

blocks.heading: Self-hosted Llama 3 for the most sensitive matters
paragraphs: The most privileged New York legal matters and the most proprietary financial research require self-hosted deployment — ClickMasters deploys Llama 3 70B on client infrastructure for New York applications where data sovereignty is non-negotiable.
